title: 第五章 站稳脚跟第六章 京海闯荡
lines: 派出所的人第二天就来了。
来的是昨天那个中年警察，姓周，叫周建国，龙城镇派出所的副所长，四十出头，脸圆圆的，看着和和气气，但眼神跟钩子似的，看人一眼能把人看穿。
他骑着边三轮，后座上坐着赵大勇。
赵大勇从车上下来的时候，脸上青一块紫一块的，不知道是被谁打的。他耷拉着脑袋，跟霜打的茄子似的，哪还有昨天砸摊子时的威风。
周建国把沈南枝叫到一边，拿出本子，一边记一边问：“损失统计了吗？”
“统计了，”沈南枝从兜里掏出一张纸，“被踩碎的饰品二十三件，按批发价算，一共六十九块。被损坏的桌子一张，十五块。总共八十四块。”
周建国看了看单子，点点头，把赵大勇叫过来：“人家报的损失八十四块，你认不认？”
赵大勇抬了下头，飞快地看了沈南枝一眼，又低下去了：“认。”
“那就赔。八十四块，一分不能少。”
赵大勇从兜里掏出一沓钱，数了半天，数出八十四块，递给周建国。周建国又递给沈南枝，沈南枝接过去，当着他的面又数了一遍，没错，揣兜里了。
“还有，”周建国合上本子，看着赵大勇，“你这行为属于寻衅滋事，按治安管理处罚条例，拘留五天。你有意见没有？”
赵大勇的脸一下子白了：“周所长，我、我赔钱了还不行？”
“赔钱是赔钱，拘留是拘留，两码事。”周建国说得很平静，“你要是不服，可以上诉。但上诉期间拘留照常执行。”
赵大勇的嘴唇哆嗦了两下，没再说出话来。他扭头看了一眼人群外面——白若溪站在远处的大槐树下，穿着一件浅蓝色的连衣裙，手里撑着一把花伞，正往这边看。
赵大勇看了她一眼，又低下去了。
沈南枝注意到了这个细节，心里冷笑了一声。都到这时候了，还指望白若溪来救他？白若溪那种人，用得着你的时候甜言蜜语，用不着的时候连看都不会多看你一眼。
周建国把赵大勇带上边三轮，发动车子，突突突地开走了。
围观的人慢慢散了，有人走的时候看了沈南枝一眼，眼神跟以前不一样了。以前是看不起，现在是有点——敬畏？
说不清楚。
反正沈南枝不在乎。
她回到铺子里，桂姨已经把被砸坏的摊位收拾干净了，新摆了一张桌子，上面铺了一块碎花布，饰品整整齐齐地摆着，比昨天还好看。
“姨，谢谢您。”沈南枝说。
桂姨摆摆手：“谢啥？我跟你说，赵大勇这种人，你就得治他。你软他就硬，你硬他就软。这回拘留五天，出来就不敢再来了。”
沈南枝笑了笑，没说话。她倒希望赵大勇再来，再来就有再来的办法。
赵大勇被拘留的消息，当天就传遍了整个龙城村。
村里人议论纷纷，说什么的都有。
有人说赵大勇活该，早就看他不顺眼了，仗着他爹是村长，在村里横行霸道，这回踢到铁板了。
有人说沈南枝心太狠，都是一个村的，何必把人弄进去。
还有人把话题扯到了白若溪身上——“你们说赵大勇为啥要去砸沈南枝的摊子？他跟沈南枝又没仇，是不是有人指使的？”
“谁指使？”
“还能有谁？你们想想，村里谁最见不得沈南枝好？”
“你是说白老师？不能吧，白老师多好的人。”
“好？好什么好，我跟你说，我上次亲眼看见她在村口跟赵大勇说话，两个人嘀嘀咕咕的，不知道说什么。”
“真的假的？”
“我骗你干什么？”
沈南枝没参与这些议论，但她知道村里人的嘴就是这样——今天说你好，明天说你坏，全靠一张嘴翻来翻去。白若溪以前能在村里建立“善良温柔”的形象，是因为没人跟她唱对台戏。现在沈南枝不配合了，白若溪的戏就不好唱了。
不过，这些都不是她现在最关心的事。
她现在最关心的是——扩大生产。
赵大勇的事处理完之后，沈南枝在村里贴了一张告示，招女工，做手工饰品，计件付钱，多劳多得，不拖欠工资。
告示贴出去不到半天，就有八个人来报名。
她挑了三个手脚麻利、眼神好的，加上之前那三个，现在有六个女工。她给每个人发了一套材料，教她们串珠子和绕铜丝，手把手地教，一个动作一个动作地纠正。
教了一天，六个人里只有两个能做出像样的东西。沈南枝没急，又教了一天。第三天，六个人都能做出合格的产品了，虽然速度慢，质量也一般，但至少能用。
content_en:
People from the police station came the next day.
The middle-aged policeman who came yesterday was Zhou Jianguo, the deputy director of Longcheng Town Police Station. He was in his early forties, with a round face and a friendly look, but his eyes were like hooks, and he could see through people with one glance.
He was riding a tricycle, and Zhao Dayong was sitting in the back seat.
When Zhao Dayong got out of the car, his face was bruised and he didn't know who had beaten him. His head was drooped, like an eggplant beaten by frost, and he didn't have the majesty he had when he smashed the stall yesterday.
Zhou Jianguo called Shen Nanzhi aside, took out his notebook, and asked while writing down: "Have the losses been calculated?"
"Here's the statistics," Shen Nanzhi took out a piece of paper from his pocket, "Twenty-three pieces of jewelry were trampled on, totaling 69 yuan based on wholesale price. One damaged table cost 15 yuan. A total of 84 yuan."
Zhou Jianguo looked at the list, nodded, and called Zhao Dayong over: "The loss reported was 84 yuan, do you recognize it?"
Zhao Dayong raised his head, glanced at Shen Nanzhi quickly, and then lowered his head: "Acknowledge."
"Then compensate. Eighty-four yuan, not a penny less."
Zhao Dayong took out a wad of money from his pocket, counted it for a long time, counted out eighty-four yuan, and handed it to Zhou Jianguo. Zhou Jianguo handed it to Shen Nanzhi again, and Shen Nanzhi took it and counted it again in front of him. Yes, he put it in his pocket.
"Also," Zhou Jianguo closed his book and looked at Zhao Dayong, "your behavior is considered provoking quarrels and provoking trouble. According to the Public Security Management Punishment Regulations, you will be detained for five days. Do you have any objections?"
Zhao Dayong's face suddenly turned pale: "Director Zhou, why don't I, I have to pay the money?"
"Compensation is compensation, and detention is detention, which are two different things." Zhou Jianguo said calmly, "If you are not convinced, you can appeal. However, detention will remain in effect during the appeal period."
Zhao Dayong's lips trembled twice and he said no more words. He turned and glanced outside the crowd - Bai Ruoxi was standing under the big locust tree in the distance, wearing a light blue dress, holding a flower umbrella in her hand, looking over here.
Zhao Dayong glanced at her and lowered his head again.
Shen Nanzhi noticed this detail and sneered in his heart. At this point, he still expects Bai Ruoxi to save him? People like Bai Ruoxi will talk sweetly to you when they need you, but won't even look at you when they don't.
Zhou Jianguo took Zhao Dayong into the third wheel, started the car, and drove away suddenly.
The onlookers slowly dispersed. When someone left, they glanced at Shen Nanzhi, and their eyes were different from before. I used to look down on it, but now I feel a little bit - in awe?
Can't tell.
Shen Nanzhi didn't care anyway.
She returned to the shop. Aunt Gui had already cleaned up the damaged stall and set up a new table with a piece of floral cloth spread on it and the accessories neatly arranged. It looked even better than yesterday.
"Auntie, thank you." Shen Nanzhi said.
Aunt Gui waved her hand: "Thank you for what? I'm telling you, you have to treat people like Zhao Dayong. If you are soft, he will be hard, and if you are hard, he will be soft. I will detain him for five days this time, and he will not dare to come back again after he is released."
Shen Nanzhi smiled and said nothing. She hoped that Zhao Dayong would come again, and there would be a way to do it again.
The news of Zhao Dayong's detention spread throughout Longcheng Village that day.
People in the village were talking about everything.
Some people say that Zhao Dayong deserves what he deserves. They have long disliked him. Because his father is the village chief, he is domineering in the village. This time he has been hit hard.
Some people say that Shen Nanzhi is too cruel. They all belong to the same village, so why bring people in.
Someone else brought the topic to Bai Ruoxi - "Why do you think Zhao Dayong wanted to smash Shen Nanzhi's stall? He and Shen Nanzhi have no grudges. Was it someone who instigated it?"
"Who ordered it?"
"Who else could it be? Think about it, who in the village dislikes Shen Nanzhi the most?"
"You mean Teacher Bai? No way, Teacher Bai is such a good person."
"Okay? What's good? Let me tell you, I saw her talking to Zhao Dayong at the entrance of the village last time. The two of them were mumbling and didn't know what to say."
"Really or not?"
"Why did I lie to you?"
Shen Nanzhi did not participate in these discussions, but she knew that the mouths of people in the village were like this - today they say you are good and tomorrow they say you are bad, all with one mouth. Bai Ruoxi was able to establish a "kind and gentle" image in the village because no one could compete with her. Now that Shen Nanzhi doesn't cooperate, Bai Ruoxi's play will be difficult to sing.
However, these are not her main concerns now.
What she cares about most now is expanding production.
After Zhao Dayong's matter was settled, Shen Nanzhi posted a notice in the village, recruiting female workers to make handmade jewelry, and pay by the piece.
Within half a day after the notice was posted, eight people signed up.
She selected three who were quick with their hands and feet and had good eyesight. Together with the previous three, there were now six female workers. She gave everyone a set of materials and taught them how to string beads and wind copper wire. She taught them step by step and corrected each movement.
After teaching for a day, only two out of six people could make something decent. Shen Nanzhi was not in a hurry and taught for another day. On the third day, all six people were able to make a qualified product. Although the speed was slow and the quality was average, it was at least usable.
